# Queen E's Heirr

> Queen E's Heirr (QueenE's LLC) of Slidell, Louisiana makes small-batch jams and pickled goods, and offers jam-making and etiquette classes plus etiquette and leadership training built on the J.U.D.A.H. curriculum, for students, professionals, HR leaders, and secular and faith-based organizations. Tagline: Curating Culture & Confections.

Founder: LyKinda Thibodeaux. Website: https://queenesheirr.com (formerly queenejams.com).

## Shop
- [The Shop](https://queenesheirr.com/shop/): jams (blueberry, strawberry, peach, raspberry, apple, blackberry, peppered and tropical flavors) and pickled goods (dill, sweet and savory, tart n tangy). Jars ship across the United States; checkout is by Stripe.
- [Wholesale](https://queenesheirr.com/wholesale/): case orders for retailers.
- [Locations](https://queenesheirr.com/locations/): in-store at Bayou Stuf in Lacombe, Louisiana.

## Classes and training
- [Classes](https://queenesheirr.com/classes/): STEM jam-making lab and combined jam-making and etiquette class.
- [Etiquette & Leadership](https://queenesheirr.com/training/): youth dining and social graces, student leadership academy, executive presence and dining, J.U.D.A.H. curriculum for students and professionals, and a leadership keynote.

## More
- [Queen Talk](https://queenesheirr.com/stories/): stories and pairing ideas.
- [FAQ](https://queenesheirr.com/faq/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://queenesheirr.com/privacy-policy/) · [Terms](https://queenesheirr.com/terms-of-use/)
